resources.string: Digital processing of recorded samples, not microphone hardware gain or headphone volume. Positive gain can clip; it cannot repair an already clipped input. Level meters alone do not confirm playback.
Manual mode suspends AGC, including at 0 dB. The AGC preference is retained for when manual mode is disabled.
AGC is a request, not proof of application. Hardware effects and software AGC depend on the active recording backend and PCM format; MediaRecorder does not expose this control.
Recording gain changes are pending for the next take. This take keeps its admitted gain and AGC configuration.
With AAC, the phone\'s encoder sets the gain. Manual gain and automatic gain control need WAV or FLAC.
No current PCM gain application receipt. The configured value is only a request.
The active PCM source reports manual gain disabled; this does not confirm AGC.
